card.name: Sword dance
card.tagline: Yorkshire — dancers weave swords into a six-pointed lock star, raised over the lead dancer's neck. A failed lock means symbolic beheading.
card.profile: Weapon dances incorporating swords or similar weapons are recorded throughout world history. There are various traditions of solo and mock-battle sword dances in Africa, Asia and Europe. Some traditions use sticks or clubs in place of bladed weapons, while most modern performers employ dulled replications to avoid injury.
card.insight: mock-battle dances, including many stick dances from non-sword traditions, and such common continental dances as Bouffons or Mattachins as described by Thoinot Arbeau in 1588.
